info.title: ATHENA N0 + N1 — Data Quality Gateway and Market & Opportunity Intelligence Engine
info.description:
Policy gate in front of every ATHENA node (N1–N8).

* **PASS is not engineering qualification**: it means N0's deterministic checks for the declared
  `artifact_type` and `release_stage` passed.
* **Hard-policy BLOCK is final** for its revision: no LLM output, score, approval or feedback can override it.
* Every value carries `value_origin` (CUSTOMER | MEASURED | DERIVED | MODEL_EXTRACTED) with evidence.
* No data reaches an LLM or a vendor unless the SourceRecord.v1 rights and the tenant ACLs allow it.
* Uploads are quarantined, MIME-sniffed, malware-scanned and SHA-256 addressed before anything reads them.

a PASS is ingested.

raw_payload.title: Raw Payload

rate_to_base.title: Rate To Base

quality_score.title: Quality Score
quality_score.description: advisory only; never overrides a hard policy

resolved_by_approval_id.title: Resolved By Approval Id
resolved_by_approval_id.description: set when a human REVIEW_RESOLUTION approval turned a REVIEW into PASS/REWORK; BLOCK decisions are never resolvable

qualification_disclaimer.title: Qualification Disclaimer
qualification_disclaimer.default: PASS means the artifact satisfied N0's checks for its declared artifact_type and release_stage. It is not engineering qualification or product certification.

MarketAmount-Input.title: MarketAmount
MarketAmount-Input.description:
Amount as stated by the source. Deliberately unconstrained in sign: N1.4 guardrails exclude
negative or malformed values per observation instead of rejecting the whole batch.

MarketAmount-Output.title: MarketAmount
MarketAmount-Output.description:
Amount as stated by the source. Deliberately unconstrained in sign: N1.4 guardrails exclude

MarketObservation-Input.title: MarketObservation.v1
MarketObservation-Input.description:
One piece of market evidence: a tender, an award, a trade statistic, a budget line, an
interview or a CRM fact. ``spend_type`` is decided by N1, not by the submitter.

related_evidence_ids.title: Related Evidence Ids
related_evidence_ids.description: e.g. an award lists the notice it awards

MarketObservation-Output.description:

interview or a CRM fact. ``spend_type`` is decided by N1, not by the submitter.

win_probability.title: Win Probability
win_probability.description: always null: no calibrated model exists yet

parameter.title: Parameter
parameter.description: snake_case with a unit suffix, e.g. output_voltage_v

Requirement.title: Requirement.v1
Requirement.description:
One value. ``value_origin`` says who stated it: the customer, a measurement, N0's own
deterministic derivation, or a model extraction awaiting human confirmation.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: verified_real_sam counts only non-synthetic, VERIFIED_BUDGET, reviewer-attested, fresh, in-category, de-duplicated evidence. Synthetic records, TAM proxies and unattested estimates are reported separately and never counted as verified real SAM.

license.title: License

allowed_vendor_ids.title: Allowed Vendor Ids
allowed_vendor_ids.description: vendors this source may be transmitted to; empty = none

SourceRecord.title: SourceRecord.v1
SourceRecord.description: Rights and permitted use of one data source, per tenant. Nothing flows until APPROVED.
